name: Nonprofit Operations
description: Starter pack for churches, charities and associations: governance cycles, fundraising, grant reporting, volunteers and compliance.

definitions.title: Daily donation receipt logging
definitions.note: Log incoming donations and issue receipts same day.

definitions.title: Weekly pledge report
definitions.note: Prepare the pledge report showing who paid and what remains.

definitions.title: Weekly donor thank-you letters
definitions.note: Send thank-you letters for the week's donations.

definitions.title: Weekly volunteer schedule review
definitions.note: Confirm volunteer coverage for next week's programs.

definitions.title: Monthly bank reconciliation
definitions.note: Reconcile all bank accounts monthly and file the working papers.

definitions.title: Monthly grant report
definitions.note: Update each grant's spent and remaining amounts.

definitions.title: Monthly board pack preparation
definitions.note: Compile financials, program updates and decisions for the board pack.

definitions.title: Quarterly board meeting minutes filing
definitions.note: File signed board minutes and action items.

definitions.title: Quarterly impact metrics update
definitions.note: Update program impact numbers for donor communications.

definitions.title: AGM preparation
definitions.note: Prepare the annual general meeting: notices, reports and elections.
steps: Draft the AGM notice and send it
Compile the annual report and financials
Prepare the election and proxy materials

definitions.title: Charitable return filing
definitions.note: Prepare the draft data and supporting reports for the annual charitable return.

definitions.title: Insurance renewal review
definitions.note: Review liability, property and event insurance before renewal.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc event planning
definitions.note: Plan a fundraising or community event - set the due date when creating it.
